Name: Name
Description: Filename of the source .edf recording – not for public display

Name: Tstart
Description: Start date and time of the recording, from the EDF header

Name: fs_ecg
Description: Sampling rate of the ECG signal as declared in the EDF header

Name: units_ecg
Description: Physical units of the ECG signal, from the EDF header

Name: N_ecg
Description: Number of data points in the ECG recording

Name: model_file
Description: Filename of the QRS detector weights used for this recording

Name: model_sha256
Description: SHA-256 of the weights file, so a result can be traced to the exact model that produced it

Name: failed
Description: True if processing failed for this recording – written as 1/0 rather than True/False. When 1, the remaining columns are blank from the point processing stopped ⚠️

Name: failure_reason
Description: Why processing failed – blank if failed is 0

Name: fs_acc
Description: Sampling rate of the accelerometer signal as declared in the EDF header

Name: units_acc
Description: Physical units of the accelerometer signal, from the EDF header

Name: N_acc
Description: Number of data points in the accelerometer recording

Name: CalibNumSamples
Description: Number of data points used for accelerometer calibration

Name: CalibErrorBefore(mg)
Description: Accelerometer miscalibration error before calibration

Name: CalibErrorAfter(mg)
Description: Accelerometer miscalibration error after calibration

Name: CalibNumIters
Description: Number of iterations it took for calibration to converge

Name: CalibOK
Description: Whether calibration was successful; 1.0 if yes,  BLANK if not

Name: CalibxIntercept
Description: Offset applied to the X-axis during calibration

Name: CalibyIntercept
Description: Offset applied to the Y-axis during calibration

Name: CalibzIntercept
Description: Offset applied to the Z-axis during calibration

Name: CalibxSlope
Description: Multiplication factor applied to the X-axis during calibration

Name: CalibySlope
Description: Multiplication factor applied to the Y-axis during calibration

Name: CalibzSlope
Description: Multiplication factor applied to the Z-axis during calibration

Name: HR_min
Description: Lowest 10-minute average heart rate in the recording

Name: HR_max
Description: Highest 10-minute average heart rate in the recording

Name: HR_mean
Description: Mean of the 10-minute average heart rates across the recording

Name: HR_rest_robust
Description: Resting heart rate: median of the 10-minute average heart rates during the night-time periods with very low acceleration (below the pre-defined sleep_threshold_mg cut-point)

Name: median_daily_rmssd
Description: Median HRV (RMSSD) across overnight rest windows

Name: hours_sleep_sedentary
Description: Time spent below the very light activity cut-point across the whole recording

Name: hours_very_light
Description: Time spent between the very light and light activity cut-points across the whole recording

Name: hours_light_activity
Description: Time spent between the light and moderate activity cut-points across the whole recording

Name: hours_mvpa
Description: Time spent at or above the moderate cut-point across the whole recording (moderate to vigorous physical activity)

Name: wear_time_ECG_10s
Description: Proportion of 10-second windows in which the device was worn. Despite the name this is a proportion, not a duration

Name: prop_ECG_passed_finalQC
Description: Proportion of segments passing final quality control, including non-wear time

Name: prop_ECG_worn_passed_finalQC
Description: Proportion of segments passing final quality control, excluding non-wear time – use this as the primary signal quality metric as it is not diluted by non-wear

Name: frac_RR_imp
Description: Proportion of segments where the R-R interval was imputed rather than measured

Name: index
Description: Time from the start of the recording

Name: device_worn
Description: TRUE if the device was worn during this 10-second window. A perfectly flat trace is treated as non-wear (FALSE)

Name: clipped_5perc_thrs
Description: TRUE if more than 5% of samples in the 10-second window exceeded the ecg_clip_mv limit, meaning the signal was saturated and had to be clipped. FALSE = OK

Name: passed_initialQC
Description: True if the segment was worn, not saturated, and within the variance and peak-to-peak limits. Only these segments go to beat detection. When FALSE no beat detection is attempted, so N_beats and every beat-level column are blank ⚠️ and passed_finalQC is FALSE.

Name: N_beats
Description: Number of heartbeats the QRS detector found in the segment.

Name: N_RR
Description: Number of physiologically plausible R-R intervals, after discarding any outside (rr_min_ms,  rr_max_ms)

Name: RRm_raw
Description: Median R-R interval measured in the window

Name: rr_Cover
Description: Fraction of the window covered by valid R-R intervals. Windows below rr_cover_min fail final quality control.

Name: rr_sd
Description: Standard deviation of the valid R-R intervals in the window.

Name: rr_outliers
Description: Number of R-R intervals longer than the rr_outlier_factor multiple of the window median. Indicates outliers, usually missed beats.

Name: qrs_snr
Description: Signal-to-noise ratio of the detected QRS complexes, comparing the window-level median QRS blueprint against the window standard deviation from it.

Name: qrs_amp
Description: Amplitude of the median QRS complex in the window.

Name: rmssd
Description: Root mean square of successive differences between valid R-R intervals in the window.

Name: passed_finalQC
Description: True if the segment's beat detections met all quality thresholds. Always false when passed_initialQC is false. When FALSE, RRm_raw is blank ⚠️

Name: time
Description: Timestamp of the start of the 10-second segment.

Name: acc_raw
Description: Mean movement magnitude over the segment, after baseline removal. Blank where the device was not worn.

Name: acc_clipped
Description: Proportion of accelerometer samples in the segment that went off the scale. Despite the name this is a proportion, not a boolean flag.

Name: RRm_imputed
Description: Median R-R interval, imputed where it could not be measured. Use this for analysis.

Name: RRm_isImputed
Description: True where RRm_imputed was filled rather than measured.

Name: acc_imputed
Description: Movement magnitude, imputed where it could not be measured. Use this for analysis.

Name: acc_isImputed
Description: TRUE where acc_imputed was imputed rather than measured.

Name: HRm_imputed
Description: Window heart rate derived from RRm_imputed as 60000 / RRm_imputed.
